description: Change the deadline of one queued or scheduled task and re-pick its cleanest window inside it. Use when: the user moves the due time, earlier or later ("by 6pm instead"). Do not use to delay the start inside the same deadline (use postpone_task), to run now (use expedite_task) or to stop it (use cancel_task). Behavior: rewrites only this task in the local queue, clears its earliest start and quota rule, re-reads the grid forecast; no login. A repeat call only re-picks the hour. Returns: status, scheduled_for, new_deadline. Rejects running, finished or unknown tasks and a past deadline.

deadline.description: The new due time, ISO-8601 with offset, earlier or later than the current one and in the future, e.g. '2026-05-12T18:00:00+02:00' for "by 6pm instead".

task_id.description: Id of the queued or scheduled task to move, e.g. 't-3f2a…', from the schedule_task reply or the check_queue_status list.

name: update_deadline
